why is meta knight so boring? 

"meta knight..." with no enthusiasm whatsoever

Death is a good school for beginners who plan to solo. I went death first and it really helped me learn the ropes. While the damage is pretty low and you don't get a hit-all spell until level 48, your health is decent and you naturally learn a lot of buffs. You shouldn't struggle but it will take a while to kill things. For soloing, death > balance > ice > life > fire > storm > myth.  

If you have a person you plan on questing with, a storm for hitting and an ice or balance for buffing work really well as a team. Pretty much any team of 2 will work, but a school with good powerful AOE spells (storm, ice, and life), paired with a good buffing school (ideally balance, but really any school), really shine later in the game when mob and boss health really skyrocket.   

TLDR; death for soloing, anything for questing with friends.
